rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the barn is mainly for keeping cattle or other farm animals.

example.english: Those cows all sleep in the barn at night.
example.traditional: 嗰啲牛夜晚都喺牛棚瞓。
example.jyutping: go2 di1 ngau4 je6 maan5 dou1 hai2 ngau4 paang4 fan3

rows.note: Use this when the barn is specifically a farm building for storing grain or other harvested crops.

example.english: This barn is used to store harvested grain.
example.traditional: 呢座穀倉用嚟儲存收割返嚟嘅穀物。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 guk1 cong1 jung6 lai4 cyu5 cyun4 sau1 got3 faan1 lei4 ge3 guk1 mat6
